fences.rule: The partition or dimension set as the universe an enumerator counts against is denominator-manufactures'; the moment the exhaustion of that container list is read as the exhaustion of the members is here, and what changes across is what is taken as done.
fences.case: The census whose enumerators complete the address file and count nobody with no address: the address file as a universe is Filing classes there, and the stop when every address has been opened is Every address visited here.

fences.rule: What a named axis produces, the limiting members it conscripts at its ends, is form-yields'; the walk that closes on those ends while the subject stays open is here, so the same axis yields there and stalls here.
fences.case: A seriation from a clock the holder never started to a clock the holder wrote, whose author stops at the pause paper: the endpoints it conscripted are Endpoint demand there, and the finished walk read as a finished universe is Both ends named here.

fences.rule: A member that was reachable and not sayable, and can be restated in the first register once said in another, is here; a member that cannot be restated flat without losing its truth was the register's own and is register-yields'.
fences.case: The legal register that names every stall with a docket and has no sentence for a stall made of singletons: once the singleton stall is said in the ecological register it restates flat, so it is Restatable once found here.

fences.rule: What a grain admits and forbids, the frame's required parts, is item-grains'; the moment the frame's refusal is read as the world's having no such member is here.
fences.case: The vaccine trial's diary card, whose ticked boxes for solicited reactions run several times the rate of anything volunteered in the blank: the card's parts fix the unit there, and the trial's list of reactions read as the card's list is No box for it here.

fences.rule: The edge of what a reasoner can see, held as an edge, is context-horizons'; the same edge mistaken for the subject's end, 'I found no more' said as 'there are no more', is here.
fences.case: An enumerator of stalls who has run climbs and never a census: the address list's stall absent from its window is No door in the wall there, and the emptied memory felt as an emptied subject is Never met one here.

fences.rule: A stall of the enumeration's own growth is here; what a composition of passes yields, a critic seat's verdict distribution or what two nets of different make find, is composition-yields'.
fences.case: Thirty-eight critiques across three fleets all returning admit-with-repairs: a stall of the judge's menu, Verdict menu there, and not a stall of any list's growth.
